title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. translated_title: 用代码解决视觉问题：编码智能体是比视频模型更强的视觉推理器
translated_abstract: 视频生成模型越来越多地被当作视觉推理器来评估：给定第一帧和自然语言提示，模型能否生成执行指定任务的视频？这一范式被认为具有优势，因为推理是视觉媒介原生的，直接在帧中展开，而不是通过语言或代码。然而，这种原生路线是否确实是通往视觉推理的更可靠路径，尚未在相同条件下与符号化替代方案进行过对比检验。因此，我们在完全相同的输入、输出规范和评估器条件下，向两种媒介提出相同的任务：编码智能体不是对像素进行去噪，而是编写一个程序来渲染答案视频，再由未经修改的基于规则的评估器进行评分。在VBVR-Pro-Bench（Xu et al., 2026）上——一个包含500个实例、跨越五个认知类别、具有符号化真值的测试套件——编码智能体接收与视频模型相同的第一帧和提示，实验结果表明编码智能体展现出了更强的视觉推理能力。
tldr: 该论文在完全相同的输入、输出规范和评估器条件下，让编码智能体通过编写程序渲染答案视频来与视频生成模型直接对比，证明了编码智能体是比视频模型更强大的视觉推理器。
en_tdlr: Under identical inputs, output specifications, and evaluators, coding agents that render answer videos by writing programs are demonstrated to be stronger visual reasoners than video generation models.
